column2: be deemed to be included in the moneys allocated
to  the  corresponding  activities  appearing  in  the
Resolution  passed  by  Parliament  under  paragraph  (2)  of
Article  150  of  the  Constitution  on  December  21,  2018,
making provision for loans to be raised in terms of relevant
laws whether in or outside Sri Lanka, for and on behalf of the
Government, in respect of which provision for expenditure
for providing the services specified in the Schedules to such
Resolution for the period commencing on January 01, 2019
and ending on April 30, 2019, such loans shall be deemed to
be raised under section 2 (1) (b) of this  Act.
